description.en-US: Use an optional emotion voice pack for Windows CUDA V3 Japanese speech. References are prepared at startup.
description.zh-CN: 为 Windows CUDA V3 日语语音启用可选情绪包，启动时提前准备参考音频。

description.en-US: Default off. Install the optional voice-kurisu-emotions pack and restart. Turning this off restores default reference speech.
description.zh-CN: 默认关闭。安装可选情绪参考包并重启后生效，关闭后恢复默认参考语音。
